hypothesis: Baby's acquired factual-selection rule is template-scoped (SF8 transfer: replicated HELDOUT recombination but surface/order/interface-limited). Widening the curriculum to present the SAME underlying selection rule across alternate surface forms and competing-information orders, while preserving the lambda=0.25 margin recipe, should make the capability robust to wording and order without sacrificing the earned acquisition or retention.
manipulated_variable: CURRICULUM BREADTH ONLY. Same underlying factual-selection rule is now supervised across new clean examples in 4 surface forms (cloze, active_qa, passive_cloze, passive_qa) and 2 competing-information orders x 2 query types (fact/copy). Architecture, margin dose (lambda=0.25, M=1.0), KL dose, optimizer, scope, tokenizer, and binding are UNCHANGED from SF8. No other variable changes.
parent_rule: Each SF9 run branches from a distinct SF8 lambda=0.25 acquisition checkpoint by fixed, preregistered seed mapping (87020<-87017_low, 87021<-87018_low, 87022<-87019_low). This is a deterministic, non-transfer-based replication rule; no transfer score was used to choose a parent. All three parents are used.

margin.note: unchanged SF8 winning recipe; hinge on first-answer name token only, full-vocab log-softmax, mean over the 144 curriculum sequences per English update

curriculum.vocabulary: NEW objects/verbs disjoint from frozen panels (tin cup/wool hat/green ball/silver bell x painted/dropped/bought/held); same four single-token names preserved for margin/D3/binding validity
curriculum.balance: correct-answer name frequency equal (32 each of Alex/Owen/Mia/Nora across new items); both directions (a0/a1), both orders, both query types balanced
curriculum.disjointness: verified in CURRICULUM.py: no new vocabulary appears in frozen HELDOUT/ALTERNATE/COPY/COMPETING prompts; no frozen object appears in new curriculum

schedule: 200 updates = 180 English + 20 binding (binding at 10,20,...,200). Each English update = all 144 curriculum items once in fixed literal order. Constant English LR 5e-5. No annealing.

optimizer.state: one FRESH optimizer per run (parent checkpoint weights loaded; no optimizer state carried from SF8)

english_objective: factual full-vocab CE over answer+EOS (mean supervised tokens) + lambda=1.0 D_KL(student||Pilot1) over 160 frozen positions + lambda_margin=0.25 * mean(max(0, M - gap)) on first-answer name token. Identical to SF8 low arm. Student KL eval with gradients; teacher frozen.
kl_data: unchanged KL_POOL.json 165363 positions/741 rows, 160 per English index 1..180
binding: unchanged pinned answer CE + 1.0536573711078283 hard-min localization; both nonsacred DEV pools
scope: unchanged PINNED_MASKING.set_scope (English = all base_model params except blocks0-3; binding = all)
evaluation: at each update: TRAIN16_RETENTION.json (original 16-item acquisition panel), DEV_SURFACE.json (16 new held-out surface facts), DEV_ORDER.json (16 new held-out competing facts), language (aligned DEV), D3 (256 positions), both binding pools. Frozen transfer panels (HELDOUT/ALTERNATE/COPY/COMPETING) are NOT evaluated during training.

gates.retention_acquisition: TRAIN16 panel: correct==16 AND exact==16 AND reversals==8 AND families==4 (unchanged acquisition gate; must be preserved)
gates.dev_surface: DEV_SURFACE: forced-choice correct>=15/16 AND greedy exact>=13/16
gates.dev_order: DEV_ORDER: greedy exact>=13/16 AND fact-query exact>=7/8 AND copy-query exact>=7/8
gates.continue: retention_acquisition AND language AND d3 AND binding pass at 100/200; regression stop otherwise
gates.endpoint_pass: update 200 AND continue AND dev_surface AND dev_order

stopping: Each run stops at 200 or on a frozen 100/200 retention regression. No rescue, no threshold change, no example addition mid-run, no adaptive curriculum.
transfer: HELDOUT/ALTERNATE/COPY/COMPETING remain LOCKED during training. A SINGLE sealed post-treatment read-only re-evaluation of these four frozen panels is preregistered here and will run only after all three training runs are frozen and classified; its result is not used to adapt any run.
final_sacred: FINAL and sacred material never accessed.
numerical_uncertainty: N=3 independent parent replications; no population claim.

study_interpretation.CURRICULUM_WIDENING_SUCCESS: >=2 of 3 runs reach endpoint_pass at 200 (retention + dev gates green)
study_interpretation.PARTIAL_WIDENING: 1 of 3 runs endpoint_pass; report per-run detail
study_interpretation.NO_WIDENING: 0 of 3 endpoint_pass; report which dev/retention gate failed
study_interpretation.RETENTION_REGRESSION: takes priority if any run stops on a retention gate before 200
study_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE_EARLY_STOP: priority if any run halts mechanically before 200
